description: Registry manifest for all DCP contract schemas — tracks promotion level, validation state, CI gates, and enforcement side for each contract.

contracts.description: One entry per .schema.json file in schemas/dcp/ (excluding this manifest schema itself).

ci_gates.description: CI job or step names (from .github/workflows/) that exercise this contract. Only names that actually exist in CI. Empty if no real gate exists.

contract_version.description: Operational semver version of this contract entry.

enforcement_side.description: Which enforcement surface owns this contract: deterministic (hard-block capable), llm_advisory (never blocks), or human (approval gate).

instance_files.description: Fixture/instance files in the repo that instantiate this schema.

level.description: L0–L3 promotion ladder level. L0=DRAFT, L1=RECONCILED, L2=WIRED, L3=LOCKED.

runtime_consumers.description: Source files that consume/validate instances of this contract at runtime. Empty array when none known on this branch.

runtime_producers.description: Source files that produce instances of this contract at runtime. Empty array when none known on this branch.

schema_file.description: Path relative to repo root of the .schema.json file.

schema_version.description: Value of the schema's own schema_version const (e.g. dcp-red-lane-taxonomy.v0). Use UNKNOWN if the schema has no const.

validation_state.description: Current promotion/validation state of this contract.

manifest_version.description: Semver version of this manifest file format.

title: DcpContractsManifest
